C203.notes: SER AS-IN-001. Photo confirmed (no text drip). Value side रुपया · big 1 · RUPEE · 2001 · Noida dot · wheat ears flanking. Everyday Republic of India pocket weight — chai / auto-rickshaw / kirana odd-rupee. Country #32 — first India / South Asia. India flips now 1.
C203.story: A 2001 1 rupee coin from India. The value side shows रुपया (rupee in Hindi), a big 1, the word RUPEE and the year 2001, flanked by grain stalks, with the small dot mint mark of the Noida mint. The obverse shows the Ashoka Lion Capital. Struck in stainless steel.
